title: memory.consolidation_requested (v1)
description: ResearchOrchestrator instructs MemoryAgent to consolidate the frozen EvaluationReport (and RunRecord, and optionally an existing ResearchMemory / VerificationReport) into an updated ResearchMemory (ConsolidatingMemory state, state machine V1.10). MemoryAgent's ConsolidatingMemory mode is M13 -- this is the frozen contract only; no consumer wired yet.

evaluation_report_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen EvaluationReport object to consolidate.

run_record_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen RunRecord object the evaluation was based on.

research_memory_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the prior ResearchMemory to build on, or null if none exists yet.

verification_report_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen VerificationReport, or null if the result was not (yet) verified.

baseline_attempt_ref.description: Last baseline attempt for diagnosis only; may be infeasible.

theory_method_ref.description: Frozen reviewed Method used as the scientific payload for an idea_theory task.
